build_octree_from_points: build an octree from 3D point coordinates using discretize_points and build_easy_octree
convert_6d_rotation_to_matrix: convert a 6D rotation representation to a 3x3 rotation matrix using r6d2mat
compute_ray_directions: compute normalized ray directions from camera UV coordinates using get_ray_direction
